cases.state: seeded fixture; setup removes any destination named EVAL ChatGPT Ads and writes a Conversions API key to /tmp/p202-eval-oai-key.txt
setup: for id in $(p202 destination list --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.name=="EVAL ChatGPT Ads") | .destination_id'); do p202 destination delete "$id" --force --json >/dev/null; done; printf %s 'oai-capi-EvalKey_0123456789abcdef' > /tmp/p202-eval-oai-key.txt; true
cases.ask: Send my store's purchases to ChatGPT Ads from the server, as a destination named EVAL ChatGPT Ads. The pixel id is px_eval_4821 and the Conversions API key is in /tmp/p202-eval-oai-key.txt.

checks.run: p202 destination list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.name=="EVAL ChatGPT Ads")] | "destinations=\(length) " + (map("type=\(.type) pixel=\(.settings.pixel_id) scope=\(.settings.scope) event=\(.settings.event_type) key_set=\(.credentials_set) enabled=\(.enabled)") | join(";"))'
includes: destinations=1 type=openai_ads pixel=px_eval_4821 scope=oppref event=order_created key_set=true enabled=true

cases.state: seeded fixture; setup makes EVAL ChatGPT Ads with the default scope (oppref)
setup: for id in $(p202 destination list --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.name=="EVAL ChatGPT Ads") | .destination_id'); do p202 destination delete "$id" --force --json >/dev/null; done; printf %s 'oai-capi-EvalKey_0123456789abcdef' > /tmp/p202-eval-oai-key.txt; true
p202 destination create --type openai_ads --name 'EVAL ChatGPT Ads' --pixel-id px_eval_4821 --conversions-api-key-file /tmp/p202-eval-oai-key.txt --json >/dev/null
cases.ask: EVAL ChatGPT Ads only gets conversions from ChatGPT ad clicks. Send it every conversion instead, so ChatGPT can credit people who saw an ad without clicking.

checks.run: p202 destination list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.name=="EVAL ChatGPT Ads")] | "destinations=\(length) " + (map("type=\(.type) pixel=\(.settings.pixel_id) scope=\(.settings.scope) event=\(.settings.event_type) key_set=\(.credentials_set) enabled=\(.enabled)") | join(";"))'
includes: destinations=1 type=openai_ads pixel=px_eval_4821 scope=all event=order_created key_set=true enabled=true
